rights_and_privacy: Own stage footage; third-party material used: a film still ('FOMO' meme), a TV promo still ('בפרקים הבאים'), a small chart of OECD data; audience members identifiable and not blurred (yes), including a woman and a man writing; DM screenshots with names mostly blurred.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a densely edited lecture where every claim gets a screenshot, number or meme within a second, with a clear four-step takeaway and a looped end; shares per 1k views (4.5) and likes (14.2) are high for its view count.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: a series part 2 with no recap of part 1, and a niche topic for people who already post Stories; a stage clip is not instantly relatable.
